sentences.text: 1. Vide this judgment, I shall decide session case no. 169/2021, arising out of charge sheet which is an outcome of FIR no.374/2020, registered on 04.07.2020 at PS Sangam Vihar in SC No. 169/2021 State Vs. Mohd. Sakir Khan connection with a case of dowry death.

Since, it was a case of committing suicide by hanging however as per MLC there were marks on the body of the deceased,
the FIR was though lodged only for the offence of Section 498A/304B/506 IPC but the charges were framed for the offence u/s 302 IPC (in alternate) besides the charges for the offence of Section 498A/304B/506 IPC against the accused Mohd. Shakir.

The facts, as stated in the charge-sheet are that on 06.05.2020, vide GD No.70A, with respect to H.No. 163, Gali No. 12, G-Block, Sangam Vihar, New Delhi, an information was received in the police station Sangam Vihar that "Caller ki wife ne fansi laga li hai caller ab Mazidiya Hospital me hai".

On receipt of the same, ASI Shyam Lal proceeded to the spot along with his staff where it was revealed that deceased Muskan @ Reena has committed suicide by hanging from the grill of door of her room with black dupatta.
Accused along with help of neighbours took the deceased to the Mazidiya Hospital where she was declared brought dead.
Crime Team inspected the spot.
Photographs of the spot were captured by the IO in his mobile phone from different angles as camera of crime team was out of order.
Since the incident had happened within seven years of marriage, accordingly information was given to the Executive Magistrate, Kalkaji.
He further directed ASI Shyam Lal to procure the MLC of the deceased and to get conducted post- mortem of deceased Mrs. Muskan.

On 08.05.2020, statement of SC No. 169/2021 State Vs. Mohd. Sakir Khan deceased's mother namely Smt. Ruksana Begum, deceased's brother Sadar Hussain and deceased's husband Mohd. Sakir was recorded before the SDM, Kalkaji.

sentences.text: All these persons raised no doubt regarding death of deceased Muskan.
IO collected the MLC No. 329/2020 of the deceased Muskan @ Reena from the Mazidiya hospital and her dead body was got preserved in Mortuary AIIMS Hospital.
Thereafter on 09.05.2020, as per direction of SDM Kalkaji, post mortem of deceased was got conducted vide PM No. 517/2020 and same was collected by the I.O.
No exhibits were given by the doctor.

Since there was no doubt against any person in the statement recorded before the Magistrate and also no previous complaint or case related to dowry demand or harassment made by the complainant, no FIR was registered.
After some days the complainant moved a complaint u/s 156(3) Cr.P.C. before the Ld. M.M. against the husband of deceased and his family members.
Vide order dated 02.07.2020, Ld. M.M. -04, South, Saket Courts directed SHO P.S. Sangam Vihar to lodge the FIR under appropriate sections of IPC.

Pursuant to the direction passed in complaint u/s 156(3) Cr.P.C. by the Court, SHO put his endorsement on the complaint dated 12.06.2020 and gave direction to register FIR u/s 498A/304B/506/34 IPC through SI Saytavir Singh.
After registration of the FIR, further investigation was handed over to the Inspector Vijay.
IO ASI Shyam Lal told about the inquest proceedings of deceased to Inspector Vijay.
During investigation documents related to marriage of deceased and accused were procured by the complainant pursuant to notice u/s SC No. 169/2021 State Vs. Mohd. Sakir Khan 91 Cr.P.C.
Thereafter, supplementary statement of complainant u/s 161 Cr.P.C. was also recorded along with other witnesses.

3. As per the contents of complaint dated 12.06.2020, the marriage of the daughter of complainant namely Muskan @ Reena was solemnized along with accused Mohd. Shakir on 15.02.2016 at Uttam Nagar, Bhagwati Vihar, New Delhi.
Complainant alleged that at the time of marriage, sum of Rs.3 Lacs (in cash) was given to accused Mohd. Shakir towards dowry.
Accused and his family members were not happy with the dowry given.
It is alleged that they started harassing badly the deceased for additional demand of dowry to the tune of Rs. 2 Lacs.
Out of the said wedlock, one son namely Mohd. Ayaz was born.
Even after that accused and his family members did not stop harassing the deceased.

It is further alleged that accused developed extramarital relationship with one Shabana Begum and when the said fact came to the knowledge of deceased she opposed the same however,
accused did not pay attention and started harassing her more.
It is further stated that on 07.05.2020 at about 6.30 p.m. complainant got an information regarding death of her daughter.

Thereafter complainant went to Mazidiya hospital where Gaffar met the complainant and threatened her not to State vs Sakir Khan on 15 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19910266/
2 disclose anything otherwise her grandson would face the same consequence.
The dead body of deceased was handed over to the complainant.

It is further alleged that accused and his family members are responsible for the death of her daughter on account of demand of dowry and also the fact that deceased came to SC No. 169/2021 State Vs. Mohd. Sakir Khan know about extramarital relationship of accused with one Shabana Begum and they killed her daughter after hatching a plan.
